Two commits broke it. Both are fixed in source and `npm test` is green (517/517). I haven't committed anything.

- **`958d3ae` (formatMoney thousands separators):** the cents part used `padEnd(2, "0")` where it needs `padStart`, so 1 cent printed as `$0.10`. I changed it to `padStart` in `src/money.js`. The comma grouping is kept.
- **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork):** `taxable` was set to `subtotal`, so tax ignored order-level codes like SPRING10. It is now `subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. Line discounts, `lineDiscounts`, `taxable` in the result, and the empty-invoice check are untouched.

The 8 failures were 4 in money, 2 in invoice and 2 in render. The two render failures were knock-on effects of those same two bugs.
